review_description: Adam was really helpful from start to finish. We couldn't believe how quickly this was done. We received a great quote and then after accepting the quote our solar was installed and connected within a week and a half. We had an issue with our circuits, Adam and Jay were accommodating and willing to get this fixed for us. Highly recommend this team, which we have already with our friends.

From my first engagement with Outback Solar which commenced with an onsite inspection I have found the experience to be very professional and very competitive in pricing model. They addressed any concerns I had and once I had agreed t accept their quote their interaction with me regarding the installation process was brilliant. On the day of installation, the sales consultant contacted me on two (2) occasions to ensure I was happy with process. I would highly recommend Outback Solar to anyone who was considering installing a solar panel solution.
Very helpful with great understanding of our requirements,fast installation and great customer service

The install was in a remote area, so not many installers to choose from. Pre- and post-sales service was good, and the salesperson didn't try to BS me, unlike certain other companies that quoted me.The installation and meter box upgrades were prompt and hassle-free, which is very important when you live 600km from the site.Components were of high quality, price was reasonable, and workmanship was excellent.
